# Moon audio credits

Every sound in this folder is cut from a field or foley recording that its author released into the public domain.
No attribution is required for any of them; the authors are credited here with thanks.
`tools/moon-audio.json` holds the exact excerpt and processing of each file, and `tools/place-audio.py --set moon` rebuilds them.

## Files

- `breath.mp3` is cut from "Gas Mask breath" by Nuclearoid, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/Nuclearoid/sounds/435825/.
- `fan.mp3` is cut from "Computer Hum 3" by elle-trudgett, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/elle-trudgett/sounds/146950/.
- `step_boot_1.mp3` is cut from "Footsteps on concrete" by florianreichelt, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/florianreichelt/sounds/459964/.
